Solution written to **`/home/kara/SOLUTION.md`** (301 lines).

## What I found and verified

**Root cause:** The workflow conflates the Go *module path* with the GitHub *repo host path*. `actions/checkout`'s `repository:` expects `OWNER/REPO`, but the workflow used `wojons/consensus` — which is only the module name declared in `go.mod`, not a real repository.

| Identity | Value |
|---|---|
| Go module path | `github.com/wojons/consensus` |
| Real repo host path | `github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/consensus` |
| Branch / HEAD | `master` / `576dc076c9c3db113c8fd66edea50345583b6205` |

**Evidence collected by actually running the probes:**
- `git ls-remote --heads https://github.com/wojons/consensus` → exit 128, `could not read Username` (repo doesn't exist)
- `git ls-remote --heads https://github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/consensus` → exit 0, `refs/heads/master`
- Go itself reproduces the failure: `go mod tidy` runs the same `git ls-remote` against the module path and dies with exit 128
- A local-path `replace github.com/wojons/consensus => /tmp/consensus-real` builds and resolves fine (Go validates the replacement against the *import* path, so host/module mismatch is irrelevant)
- After using the correct checkout: all `internal/*` + `pkg/*` tests pass; only `demo` fails — a **pre-existing, unrelated** `TestSmokeKeyless` failure (mock LLM returns HTTP 400 "model ambiguous"), now visible because checkout no longer masks it
- The pre-push guard script returns `OK`/exit 0 for the real repo and `FAIL`/exit 1 for the bogus one (tested both directions)

**The fix:** change `repository: wojons/consensus` → `repository: totalwindupflightsystems/consensus`, keep the `replace github.com/wojons/consensus => ../consensus` unchanged (do **not** rewrite imports), and add the `git ls-remote --exit-code --heads` guard as a pre-push/CI step.
